name: キャンディ
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 450px !important; height: 450px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 260px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); margin: 0 !important; }

.candy-wrapper { position: absolute; top: 260px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 490px; height: 490px; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, #ff6b9d 0deg 45deg, #ffffff 45deg 90deg); animation: spin-wrapper 20s linear infinite; opacity: 0.3; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes spin-wrapper { from { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg); } to { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg); } }

.outer-candy { position: absolute; top: 260px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 470px; height: 470px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b9d 0%, #ffa500 25%, #00d4ff 50%, #c471f5 75%, #ff6b9d 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px #ffffff, 0 0 0 15px #ff6b9d, 0 0 60px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.6), inset 0 0 40px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); pointer-events: none; }
/* ▼▼▼ 修正: クラス名を変更し、クリック設定と移動防止(no-drag)を追加 ▼▼▼ */

.candy-swirl { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, #ff6b9d 0deg, #ffffff 30deg, #ffa500 60deg, #ffffff 90deg, #00d4ff 120deg, #ffffff 150deg, #c471f5 180deg, #ffffff 210deg, #ff6b9d 240deg, #ffffff 270deg, #ffa500 300deg, #ffffff 330deg, #ff6b9d 360deg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #ffffff, 0 0 30px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.5), inset 0 0 30px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); animation: spin-candy 4s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes spin-candy { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.candy-center { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 60%; height: 60%; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #ffffff, #ff6b9d); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 40px; animation: pulse-candy 2s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes pulse-candy { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); } }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 15px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 50px; height: 50px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff6b9d 0%, #ffa500 100%); clip-path: polygon(50% 100%, 20% 30%, 30% 0%, 70% 0%, 80% 30%); box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(255, 107, 157, 0.6), inset 0 -5px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); z-index: 20; animation: pointer-bounce 0.5s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }
@keyframes pointer-bounce { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-5px); } }

.pointer::after { content: '★'; position: absolute; top: -20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 32px; color: #ffa500; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.8)); animation: star-twinkle 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes star-twinkle { 0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.3) rotate(180deg); } }
/* ▼▼▼ 修正: ボタン非表示 ▼▼▼ */

#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #ff6b9d; text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ff6b9d; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Arial', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 550px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 470px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #ff6b9d !important; color: #ff6b9d !important; }
